name: Cooked & Wilted Baby Spinach (Steamed or Sautéed)
whyItWorks: Cooking tender young baby spinach leaves shrinks and wilts the leafy matrix, dramatically decreasing mechanical volume while preserving iron and folate. Far safer than raw spinach salads.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Sauté baby spinach in a pan with 1 teaspoon of olive oil or chicken broth for 2–3 minutes until fully wilted and soft.
watchOuts: Avoid raw rough spinach salads; raw leaves can ball up and irritate strictured bowel segments.
